summary: The page exhibits bidirectional text rendering artifacts in checkbox labels and an unaligned high-contrast theme styling on user messages within the dark glass aesthetic.

issues.title: Bidirectional punctuation and label spacing
issues.description: English strings in an RTL container cause periods to render on the left edge, alongside broken character spacing in multiple labels.
issues.evidence: Checkbox labels show broken words like 'dige st' and 'tele me try', and descriptions start with misplaced periods such as '.Notify me'.
issues.suggestion: Apply dir="auto" or bidi isolation to text elements and correct label typography tokens.

issues.title: Monochrome theme inconsistency
issues.description: Message bubbles use an opaque beige fill that conflicts with the monochrome dark glass theme.
issues.evidence: Chat bubbles on the left have light cream solid backgrounds rather than dark liquid-glass surfaces.
issues.suggestion: Update message bubble styles to use dark translucent glass tokens matching the design system.
